svg.title: Java RMI: a Call to the registry
svg.desc: The Call of frame 38 of jdk11-loopback.pcap, 32 bits per row: the type byte 0x50, the magic AC ED and the version 5 of a Java serialization stream, a TC_BLOCKDATA block of 34 bytes that holds the call header, an ObjID of 22 zero bytes (object 0 in the null space, the registry), operation 2 and the interface hash 0x44154dc9d4e63bdf of java.rmi.registry.Registry, then the argument, still serialized, a TC_STRING of length 7, station; JavaRmiCall keeps the object, the operation, the hash and the arguments, and names the method Registry.lookup.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
